summary: MIT $100K Pitch 2026 applications run October 14–28, 2026; the live competition is December 2, 2026. Pitch is distinct from the later Accelerate and Launch contests.

proposed_event.name: MIT $100K Pitch 2026
proposed_event.description: Pitch competition for MIT student founders and eligible teams. Entry is free; at least one current MIT student is required.

dates.date_range_text: Pitch applications October 14–28, 2026; live competition December 2, 2026. Cutoff time not published.

sources.title: MIT $100K Pitch 2026
sources.supports: Explicit 2026 application opening, closing and December 2 live competition.

sources.title: MIT $100K eligibility rules
sources.supports: Free entry; individuals or teams allowed; at least one currently registered MIT student is required.

notes: At least one registered MIT student is required on every team; individual entrants must themselves be registered MIT students.
The 2027 Launch page still asks visitors to check back for dates. The Pitch deadline must not be presented as the Launch deadline.
The source does not publish a cutoff time; none is inferred.
